Daily digest created for Alex Parent

1. Vday Party Photos

Posted by Jenna Park on Wednesday, Feb 11 at 7:19 PM in Kindergarten-Hartley

Hi Room 102 Families Our Valentine’s Day party was such a sweet success! The kids had an amazing time, and it truly wouldn’t have been possible without all of you. A heartfelt THANK YOU to our wonder teacher ms Hartley and everyone who volunteered their time, donated items, helped set up, or contributed in any way. Your generosity and support made the celebration extra special for the class. Here's a link of some photos we took today. Please let me know if you cant access it.

See you all next week! Wishing everyone a wonderful and safe super long weekend.
Omar, Jenna, & Claire

2. Newsletter

Posted by Laura Hartley on Thursday, Feb 12 at 11:16 AM in Kindergarten-Hartley

Double Author Visit on March 12th

If students would like to order books and have them signed on the day of the visit, please place orders through Riverside Book Nook. The books will be delivered on the day of the visit, and the authors will sign them for students.

*** Shipping Address when placing an order is the school’s address:

1200 Cedar Ridge Road, Riverside, CA 90000
